lineage.premise: Base independent subsets are copied from the accepted source bitfield; no graph, degree, independent-family or clique search is replayed.

input.definition: Vertices are length-depth words over0..4. Distinct words are adjacent when their first differing coordinates are adjacent on the declared five-cycle.
input.order: Base pattern by increasing saved mask, then positive child sizes lexicographically, then child family ranks in mixed radix; vertex labels are base-five integers. Clique mode applies the digit map to independent sets and inherits its order.
